title: Cardiff Castle
visualBrief: Individual enclosed Cardiff exterior: open faceted Norman keep with gate/turret, grassy motte and mapped stairs; western palace and unequal towers/roof pieces, southwest clock tower, outer and inner curtains, gate passages, named north/west bridge approaches and simplified visitor range.

nativeAxes.x: northwest along the mean of the two bridge approaches

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Exact-QID enclosing site and24 selected current PMTiles component polygons, keep courtyard and gate/bridge/stair paths.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Untagged architectural heights and roof profiles are picture-led estimates. Small motte omitted by coarse DEM is explicitly authored at10.8m; palacefloor2.8m clears retained western ground. NativeY0 follows standardDEM12.8751m.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Standard DEM misses the small motte. Its approximate10.8m plateau, keep11.2m walls, palace/clock/tower/curtain levels and individual roof profiles are picture-led estimates at mapped plan scale. Palace floor2.8m clears the coarse western ground; perimeter walls follow retained DEM.
reconstruction.scope: Whole enclosed exterior: individual keep/motte/stairs, western palace/towers/roofs, clock tower, outer and inner curtains, south entrance, north/west gate bridges and simplified mapped visitor range. No full interiors, exact sculpture/clock-face lettering, gardens or city reconstruction.
reconstruction.coordinateSpace: cardinal-authoring-xz; X east, Z south; output points rotate by the frame heading into model-local-xz
reconstruction.componentControlMethod: Union of all current standard PMTiles tile fragments for each selected component ID, retaining mapped holes; cardinal authoring coordinates rotate by frame heading at export.

geographicProposal.reviewStatus: Approximate exterior and source-terrain fit reviewed against two inspected pictures and current standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. Untagged architectural levels, motte/moat joins and navigable collision remain exterior estimates.

terrainReference.basis: NativeY0 follows retained standard viewer DEM12.8751m at anchor. Motte10.8m and palace2.8m floors are approximate exterior estimates. Curtain foundations follow coarse ground.

geographicProposal.notes: Mapped keep/courtyard, selected castle polygons and entry paths establish approximate scale and signed facing. Untagged architectural levels and terrain/moat joins remain estimates. A replacement corridor covers the two authored named bridge approaches; actual tagged-road suppression must pass before final QA. Native frame follows the mean bridge axis; inverse viewer heading restores the original cardinal fit.
geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Current source-terrain views inspected. NativeY0 follows standardDEM12.8751m at anchor. The small motte omitted by coarse DEM uses an approximate10.8m plateau; the keep court remains open, and mapped stair run joins its gate. Palace2.8m floor clears western ground. Curtains/bridge supports follow retained ground. North and west bridge decks extend through their mapped gate centers; levels and moat/approach joins are exterior estimates, not surveyed or certified walking surfaces.

scaleBasis: Current mapped castle/keep/courtyard/component outlines and approach paths supply approximate exterior scale. Two inspected pictures guide the individual silhouette.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under repository license; mapped controls © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Linked photographs are not redistributed.
dataAttribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; Protomaps; Mapzen/USGS terrain tiles.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Mapped castle/site/keep courtyard and24selected component polygons control the exterior. Component roles, wall/window arrangement, roof/gable/turret profiles and untagged heights are approximate picture-led interpretations.

NativeY0 follows standardDEM12.8751m; the small motte is not represented in that DEM and uses an approximate10.8m plateau. Palace2.8m floor, moat/terrace levels, stairs, foundations and bridge/terrain joins are approximate, not surveyed or certified walking collision.

Skyline keeps open keep/motte, simplified palace/tower/roof silhouette, clock and enclosure, omitting the modern visitor range and ornament. District adds sparse surface windows, crenellations, clocks and bridge rails. Street restores a single recessed facade row, slits, stair treads, chimneys and selected clock accents; closeup restores both facade rows and denser crenellations/trim. Full interiors, underground shelters, exact sculpture, heraldry, clock lettering and weathering are excluded.
City, trees, visitors, exact animal wall sculptures and full gardens remain host content. Physical laptop and phone performance measurements remain pending.
importReason: Retain individual shell keep/motte, western palace/towers, clock and enclosed compound in four independently authored browser levels.
